title: RoyalCrown
description: This resource pack brings sparkle and splendor to the world of Minecraft by adding crowns
body: This resource pack brings sparkle and splendor to the world of Minecraft by adding crowns - symbols of power and greatness! With their help, your character can look truly royal or regal. Crowns are varied in design, from classic gold to original ones encrusted with precious stones. Each crown gives your character a unique look and adds elegance to your gaming experience. Charming decorations that can become the calling card of your Minecraft world!
